raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant mediastinal shift to the right (trachea and heart displaced away from the opacity), which is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion. In contrast, lung collapse would cause an ipsilateral shift, and consolidation typically presents without such a dramatic shift.
